title: Startups don’t need to go viral to win customers

claims.claim: Elia Wallen, seyahat girişimi Engine'in kurucusu ve CEO'sudur.

evidence.quote: Elia Wallen, founder and CEO of travel startup Engine

claims.claim: Grant Lee, Gamma'nın kurucusu ve CEO'sudur.

evidence.quote: Gamma founder and CEO Grant Lee

claims.claim: Crystal Huang, Google Ventures'ta genel ortaktır (general partner).

evidence.quote: Crystal Huang, general partner at Google Ventures

claims.claim: Gamma, yapay zeka destekli sunum yazılımı satmaktadır ve Ambassadors programını uygulamıştır.

evidence.quote: Gamma, which sells AI-powered presentation software, managed to scale its business exponentially with a social media strategy that deployed influencers through its Ambassadors (or “Gambassador”) program.

claims.claim: Engine, orta ölçekli işletmeler için konaklama ve seyahat rezervasyonlarını yönetmektedir.

evidence.quote: His company Engine, which manages lodging and travel bookings for midsize businesses

claims.claim: Engine, dışarıdan fon almadan önce 150 milyon dolarlık rezervasyona ulaşmıştır.

evidence.quote: bootstrapped its way to $150 million in bookings before taking on any outside funding.
His company Engine, which manages lodging and travel bookings for midsize businesses, bootstrapped its way to $150 million in bookings before taking on any outside funding.

claims.claim: Elia Wallen, şirketinin ilk günlerinde potansiyel müşterileri cezbetmek için David adında bir sihirbaz kiraladıklarını belirtmiştir.

evidence.quote: Wallen also shared an in-person tactic that his company deployed during its scrappy early days: hiring a magician named David to perform tricks for prospective clients at events and encourage them to visit the Engine’s booth.
